justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Advanced training for complex vestibular cases; no comparative data vs standard vestibular PT.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: University of Pittsburgh 3-week intensive program; significant time and travel commitment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to complex vestibular and balance cases; useful in vestibular specialty and ENT-affiliated practices.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Standard vestibular PT billing; no premium for advanced certification over standard vestibular cert.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Valued in vestibular specialty clinics; moderate employer demand above standard vestibular certification.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Complex vestibular patients benefit from advanced expertise.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Vestibular care is largely insurance-driven (older patients, Medicare), limiting cash-pay upside.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Specialization commands modest premiums and ENT referrals, but not luxury pricing.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Genuinely scarce skill set; ENTs actively seek qualified vestibular PTs.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Trainable in associates and creates a referral-driven program model that scales reasonably.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Patients usually arrive via physician referral rather than direct consumer search.
justifications.business.efficiency: Advanced coursework (Emory, APTA Neuro) is significant time/cost commitment.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Pairs well with NCS and is recognized in neuro faculty hiring as legitimate advanced practice.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Strong; vestibular PT has an active research community with regular publications.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: High curricular value for neuro and geriatric DPT content, including labs.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Strong RCT and CPG support (APTA Neurology vestibular CPGs).
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Frequently preferred for neuro faculty lines, especially with NCS.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Long pathway, but yields durable academic credibility.
